propositions: max_consecutive_repeat only detects back-to-back identical signatures and is blind to cycles of length >= 2, scoring a genuine 4-call cycle with score 1 while healthy breadth-first exploration scores 5

windowed distinct-ratio computed as set cardinality over trailing 24 tool calls divided by window size is order-insensitive and catches all cycle lengths, firing at distinct_ratio_window <= 0.50 while staying above 0.833 on healthy runs
the metric scores a loop incorrectly lower than healthy work, preventing accurate actuator triggering for repetition-based remediation in the gate

_repetition_summary must be augmented with distinct_ratio_window field reporting set cardinality of signatures in trailing REPETITION_WINDOW, rounded to 3 decimals, or None if fewer than REPETITION_WINDOW signatures exist
